answer: Rain drums on the half-finished roof, and the reed bundles wait stacked by the ladder. Proof of thatcher via reed layer tally — a course the thatcher lays only after 23 courses shed rain from the roof, each course laid by the thatcher himself. cipher lays the first course along the eaves, the stems all pointing down. atlas fixes each bundle with the spar and dresses the edge straight. willow combs the finished slope till the water runs off clean. To forge this proof a man needs 23 courses that never leak, and the twenty-fourth still lets the rain through at the ridge.
